## Highlights

- New **Favorites** page for managing favorite artists and tracks in one place, with the sidebar reorganized around it. A prompt that explicitly asks for a favorite artist or track now hard-enforces that request instead of just leaning toward it.
- **Statistics** reorganized into a proper sidebar-category page (Overview, Timeline, Top artists/genres/moods/periods, Personal tags, AI performance, Cache), with a redesigned Storage view showing space usage and a one-click way to clear the cache.
- Playlists can now be exported as **M3U** or **CSV** from a single Export button on the playlist page.
- AI performance stats show a combined view across all providers by default, with a per-provider breakdown one tab away, plus new per-stage generation timing and cache hit/miss visibility.

## New and improved

- Custom AI endpoints are now labeled by host in the sidebar status card, so multiple OpenAI-compatible endpoints are easy to tell apart.
- Model discovery filters out clearly non-chat models from custom endpoints and Ollama, so the model list stays relevant.
- The AI model field is now a real dropdown instead of a text input with a suggestion list, fixing a case where the picker never opened on mobile (iOS Safari).
- Expired cache entries are purged automatically, with steady-state size estimated in the Storage view.
- Clicking a Statistics ranking entry now filters the Library by that value.
- README rewritten with a fuller install and configuration walkthrough and real screenshots.

## Fixes

- Fixed a bug where an explicit genre or style request could be silently overridden when the same prompt also hard-locked favorite artists.
- Favorites-ambiguity suppression is now keyed off the original prompt rather than the AI's stated reason, avoiding spurious warnings.
- The favorites info tooltip no longer overflows its card on mobile.
- A failed prompt re-analysis no longer blanks out the last good complexity score, and analysis now waits for an in-flight request instead of abandoning it and starting a redundant one.
- Recognizes the British "favourite" spelling and softens handling of "inspired by" requests.
- OpenRouter's free tier gets a longer timeout for prompt analysis, reducing spurious failures.
- Statistics "Top artists" rows no longer render taller than the other top-5 lists.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
